subject: Activation path options & SLA check — Medrix MAP
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@medrix.com>
Cc: ProcureMent <procure@medrix.com>
Date: 2027-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP + suggested eval plan and hosting options (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)

Alicia — good to meet yesterday. Per our conversation I've attached a short Mutual Action Plan draft and an evaluation checklist that frames the hosting decision (hosted API, dedicated pool, private/VPC). High level thoughts below so we can sync on the close timeline: 

Goals and ask:
- Decision window: target confirmation of deployment mode + preferred region by 2027-06-14 so we can lock capacity for Q3 pilots.
- Evaluation milestones: 2-week functional PoC (baseline quality & latency), 2-week scale / perf run, legal/compliance review in parallel.

Quick pros/cons (for conversation):
- Hosted API: fastest time-to-value, shared infra, standard SLAs. Good for initial feature validation.
- Dedicated: reserved GPU pools (predictable throughput), stronger isolation, optional enterprise SLAs and throughput commitments. Slightly higher ops lead time to reserve EU capacity.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): strongest control for data residency and KMS/HSM integration; longer lead time and larger MSA/ops scope.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm target region (EU vs US) and whether you need on-prem TOS/air-gapped.
2) We schedule a 60-min technical deep-dive (runtime & security) w/ your infra + our infra eng.
3) We'll produce a tailored MAP with dates & deliverables and a price sketch for Dedicated vs Private.

See attached: Medrix_MAP_draft_v2.pdf and medrix_eval_checklist.xlsx.

Thanks — looking forward to narrowing the path.

— Jasmine Liu
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: Medrix_MAP_draft_v2.pdf (7 pages), medrix_eval_checklist.xlsx (12 rows)

From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@medrix.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procure@medrix.com>, security@medrix.com
Date: 2027-06-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + suggested eval plan and hosting options (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)

Thanks Jasmine — short version: compliance and data residency are our primary gating items. A few specifics from our side:

- Medrix requires EU data residency for patient data and audited KMS/HSM for PHI keys.
- SOC 2 Type II evidence + penetration test report needed during the legal review.
- For timeline, our internal procurement target is decision by 2027-06-14 to allow budget approval the week after.

We are open to testing Hosted for non-PHI features but for core clinical inference we will likely need Dedicated (EU) or Private. Can you get me: 
1) a short SLA summary and the difference in uptime/credits between Hosted vs Dedicated (EU)?
2) an estimated monthly cost delta for Dedicated EU vs Private on-prem (rough ballpark is fine today).

Also looping in security (security@medrix.com) and Procurement. If we can get a high-level cost & SLA summary by EOD tomorrow that would help.

Best — Alicia
Head of Product, Medrix Health
Alicia.Ramos@medrix.com

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@medrix.com>
Cc: ProcureMent <procure@medrix.com>, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-01T13:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + suggested eval plan and hosting options (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)

Alicia — thanks, that's helpful context. Quick responses inline and an adjusted MAP ask: 

- Evidence: we will share SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) and our latest pen test summary as part of the security packet — attaching the standard evidence checklist to the MAP.
- SLA: Hosted (standard) = 99.9% regional availability with standard credits; Dedicated = SLA uplift to 99.95% plus priority capacity with optional financial credits for sustained outages. I'll pull the formal SLA excerpt and a one-sheet comparison.
- Cost sketch: I'll ask our sales ops for a ballpark: early estimate request: Dedicated (EU reserved pool) is materially more than Hosted but substantially less than Private full on-prem when you amortize ops.

Proposed MAP timeline (updated) — target close and activation cadence: 
- Week 1 (2027-06-02 to 2027-06-09): Technical deep-dive + scope finalize (data flows, PHI scoping)
- Week 2 (2027-06-10 to 2027-06-16): Proof-of-concept (functional) in Hosted or Dedicated EU test pool; legal starts review in parallel.
- Week 3 (2027-06-17 to 2027-06-23): Performance & scale run; security acceptance testing.
- Week 4 (2027-06-24 to 2027-06-30): Sign-off and provisioning pathway (if Private chosen, add pre-proc change window).

If you confirm decision by 2027-06-14 we can keep the sprint intact and deliver a pilot by end of June.

Next immediate steps: 
- Can we lock a deep-dive with your infra + our runtime team on 2027-06-03 or 06-04?
- I'll follow up with internal ask to produce price sketches and SLA excerpts by EOD 2027-06-02.

Linking HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-3482 and DocuSign intent link for MAP signature: https://www.docusign.com/Medrix-MAP-signature-request

— Jasmine
Sr. AE, Redwood Inference

They'd like delivery by EOD 2027-06-02 (Procurement asked for numbers tomorrow). If we can't meet that, can we at least provide an internal one-pager and a stub cost CSV they can use to get sign-off by 2027-06-14?
